name: zeffect_cleanup_sound_refs
description: zEffect::CleanupSoundRefs deactivates runtime sound refs, removes attached sounds from the effect world, and clears attachment flags.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?CleanupSoundRefs@zEffect@@YIHPAUzEffectAnimEntry@@@Z at 0x45bfd0 currently fails with 111 unmasked mismatches after masking 12 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 101 bytes, the VC object symbol is 128 bytes with 3 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, and the triage artifact is build/vc5-verify/zeffect_cleanup_sound_refs/verify/45bfd0_byte_triage.txt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x45bfd0 iterates soundRefCount, skips null runtime refs/nodes, deactivates active runtime nodes, removes attached sounds from g_zEffect_World, clears the ref attachment flag, and returns 0.
The native smoke verifies active sound deactivation, world sound-count decrement, attached-world list compaction, and sound-ref attachment clearing.
